kind: deterministic engine simulation, not browser input

results.name: Ten distinct 25x25 maps, valid symbols, clear staging and increasing waves
All ten stages: player, supplies and three enemy entrances reachable without crossing steel or water
Ready and pause freeze simulation; resume advances fixed-step time
Vehicle collides with steel, brick, water and another tank
Two normal projectile hits destroy brick; steel survives; shots do not tunnel
Three enemy classes have distinct armour, speed and firing cadence
Enemy AI physically advances along a valid route and fires
Heavy armour absorbs normal hits; rapid damage destroys enemies and scores
Enemy shots damage beacon and cause base-loss after three effective hits
Player damage respawns with protection and exhausts three deployments
Player shots never damage their own beacon
Repair caps health; shield prevents damage; rapid fire expires and emits labelled feedback
All queued targets cleared triggers victory; restart creates independent clean state
Every undefended map naturally resolves to defeat within 180 simulated seconds
